strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Closes unresolved index build integrity blockers so later ignore filtering and bounded query phases can rely on deterministic, fail-closed, crash-recoverable index state.
Keeps codebase.index.build under the existing Rust-owned IndexCodebase permission gate while correcting platform and traversal failure behavior.
Keeps indexing as a controlled Rust-owned workspace read action with fail-closed unsupported platforms, queued-directory revalidation, and no shell/git/network execution.
Makes index build persistence recoverable from safely stale build locks without weakening active lock serialization or exposing raw file data.
Lets unattended callers avoid silent unsupported-platform success, permanent stale-lock blockage, nondeterministic truncated snapshots, and stale phase-authority review failures.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances codebase_indexing directly, with supporting progress for runtime_permission_enforcement, controlled_workspace_tools, persistent_structured_ledger, and headless_autonomous_development.
answers.new_capability: Brownie now fails closed instead of committing successful unsupported-platform index snapshots, reclaims safely stale index build locks, selects bounded directory entries deterministically, revalidates queued directory containment before reads, and validates the guard self-test in CI.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: M9.2 hardened permission, initial containment, Unix no-follow file reads, traversal bounds, and locked persistence, but unresolved review findings left non-Unix skip-success, crash-stale locks, filesystem-order truncation, queued-directory race exposure, stale AGENTS authority, and missing CI guard self-tests.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: M9.3 filtering and M9.4 query would build on index state that can silently succeed empty on unsupported platforms, remain permanently blocked after a crash, vary by directory enumeration order, or be misreviewed against obsolete Phase 0 instructions.
answers.non_duplicative: Yes. M9.2.1 corrects unresolved M9.2 integrity blockers. It does not add query, file selection, ignore filtering, diagnostics surfaces, readiness reports, or another wrapper around existing output.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. This phase corrects the existing codebase.index.build path and adds no new JSON-RPC method.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. The existing build result, snapshot, and ledger event remain the only surfaces. No report, digest, history, verdict, readiness, or preview surface is added.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: The Rust runtime/indexer fails closed on unsupported no-follow platforms, revalidates queued directories before reading entries, uses bounded lexicographic directory selection, and lets the store reclaim only safely stale build locks with old owner metadata, dead PID evidence, a nonce, and unchanged lock content.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Headless runs can recover from stale index locks, receive deterministic bounded snapshots, avoid unsupported-platform false success, and rely on CI to run the phase-value guard self-test before later autonomous M9 phases.
answers.milestone_progress: M9.2.1 removes blocking safety debt from M9.2 and prepares M9.3 Ignore-Aware Sensitive File Filtering without mixing filtering or query into this corrective phase.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: M9.2.1 changes CI guard execution and the deterministic current phase manifest. Review must confirm CI is strengthened, guard self-tests run, and the manifest describes real index runtime behavior rather than weakening generic guard enforcement.

exit_criteria: Unsupported no-follow platforms fail closed and do not commit successful empty index snapshots.
Active codebase index build locks still serialize concurrent builds.
Safely stale codebase index build locks can be reclaimed using stale age, owner PID evidence, nonce, and unchanged lock content.
Directory truncation uses bounded lexicographic selection rather than filesystem-order first-N selection.
Queued directories are revalidated for symlink replacement and canonical workspace containment before entry reads.
AGENTS.md marks Phase 0 constraints as historical and points current implementation authority at the external controller state, product charter, and current phase manifest.
CI runs pnpm guard:diagnostics, pnpm guard:phase-value, and pnpm guard:phase-value:test.
CI includes Windows fail-closed indexer coverage without claiming Windows indexing support.
No query, selection, ignore filtering, chunks, embeddings, Qdrant writes, retrieval, LLM calls, shell/git/network/service execution, or workspace mutation is added.
